svg.aria-label: Different views of the same real stack. A and B compare maximum and mean projections on a common display scale. C shows plane means across depth for each channel; channel intensities are not directly molecular abundance ratios. D uses a fixed analysis volume to show the fraction of channel-two voxels above threshold.
